Brands sent you free stuff? The C-R-A may call that income.
If your channel runs as a business, not a personal pastime, everything it earns counts. Cash or not.
Our example creator: six thousand from ads. Twenty-five hundred from a sponsor.
Plus fifteen hundred in products, kept in exchange for posts.
The bank account says eighty-five hundred. The C-R-A counts ten thousand, at fair market value.
Selling on Etsy, or driving for Uber? Since twenty twenty-four, many platforms report their sellers to the C-R-A.
Real business expenses can come off. And past thirty thousand in sales, you'll need a G-S-T number.
